craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of the sealed proof — utsāha as each consequence collapses and the maker stands. Need-free fits never (spirit nor mind); you-say staged. Rejected: (a) sway→rule → killed: sway sways. Read aloud: DONE and-NEED-free … NOR-mind's-SWAY.

lines: Done and need-free, the freed soul stands alone, you say;
yet needlessness fits spirit never — nor mind's sway.

reads_against.argmap: Needlessness — whose? → The objector's need-free spirit denied on both sides.
c1_essence: The svabhāva-view's consequences pressed: desired-by-all yet body-changes by nature; occurrence without union; needlessness fitting neither spirit nor mind; no reunion yet rebirth; mokṣa collapsed into nature; compassion-acts forcing passion-exhaustion doctrine (vv46-51).
The siddhānta sealed: nature-view abandoned as unjust, bodies famously sentient-maker-prior, arrangement-difference the flawless proof, the hetu aimed at Parameśvara unshaken (vv52-54).
